integrity: The proof uses a source-derived exact expectation identity, a classical Fourier chord inequality, conditional isotropy and dominated convergence; numerical tests corroborate finite examples and do not certify infinite quantifiers. No independent review is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact expected efficiency of Haar subspace linear-minimization oracles on Euclidean unit-ball boundary only; d=1 waiting result concerns independently resampled lines with exact minimization before the first move; no multistep convergence or floating-point assertion.
title: Sharp Haar-section oracle efficiency and the one-dimensional barrier
